```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(Haufenbildung)
```


Lets create some test data
```{r}
data <- generateClusterTestDataSimple(n=100, cluster_amount = 4)
```

This is what it looks like
```{r}
viewData(data)
```

**Apply the K-means-algorithm with K = 4**       
```{r}
clustering <- kMeans(data, K = 4)
```

Lets take a look at the clusters
```{r}
clustering
```
